validation_basis: Primary mouse study reports Msgn1 occupancy at regulatory elements near Dll3 and Dll3 reporter transactivation, with Msgn1 perturbation associated with Dll3 expression changes in presomitic mesoderm; this is sufficient for a directed general mouse TF-target mechanism edge.
limitations: Evidence is from mouse presomitic mesoderm and developmental segmentation rather than spinal cord or SCI; retain L1 exact-pair context and do not infer SCI applicability.
